# Shri Shah Home Decor

> Premium home decor shop in Ramnagar, Nainital, Uttarakhand. Expert PVC panel installation, wallpaper, false ceiling, gypsum tiles, wall stickers, and grass matting. 500+ happy clients, 10+ years experience.

Shri Shah Home Decor is the most trusted interior decoration business in Ramnagar, Nainital district, Uttarakhand. Serving customers across Ramnagar, Nainital, Haldwani, Corbett, Rudrapur, Kashipur, Almora, Bhimtal, and all of Uttarakhand.

**Phone:** +91-9548506887
**WhatsApp:** https://wa.me/919548506887
**Address:** Near Sai Mandir, Behind Guru Kirpa Hardware, Ramnagar – 244715, Nainital, Uttarakhand, India
**Business Hours:** Mon–Sat 9:00 AM–8:00 PM · Sunday 10:00 AM–6:00 PM

## Services

- [PVC Panels](https://www.shreeshahhomedecor.com/services): Waterproof, termite-proof PVC wall panels for bathrooms, kitchens, and living spaces. 100+ designs available. Price range ₹60–₹180/sqft including installation.
- [Wallpaper & 3D Wallpaper](https://www.shreeshahhomedecor.com/services): Premium imported and domestic wallpapers — 3D murals, HD photo prints, washable vinyl, floral, abstract, and tropical designs.
- [False Ceiling](https://www.shreeshahhomedecor.com/services): All types — POP, gypsum board, grid (T-bar), metal, and coffered ceilings. LED cove lighting and recessed panel light integration included.
- [Gypsum Tiles](https://www.shreeshahhomedecor.com/services): Decorative ceiling and accent wall tiles. Lightweight, fire-resistant, moisture-resistant variants available, paintable surface.
- [Wall Stickers](https://www.shreeshahhomedecor.com/services): Removable premium vinyl wall decals. Custom text, logo, and name printing available. Children's room and office themes.
- [Grass Matting](https://www.shreeshahhomedecor.com/services): UV-resistant artificial grass for balconies, terraces, rooftops, garden paths, and decorative green walls.
